{{Quote|Surely you'd like to sample the local customs&hellip; fully? Think how well you'd sleep&hellip;|Gaza, to Leia Organa|<ref name="SW88" />}}
'''Gaza''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a leading member of the ruling [[Herdessan Guild]] on his home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] climactic [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeat]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], Gaza, along with several Herdessan Guild leaders, met with a delegation from the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] to establish formal diplomatic relations. An enthusiastic participant in the Herdessan practice of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], Gaza and his confederates&mdash;led by Spokesman [[Brylin]]&mdash;instead took Alliance leader [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] prisoner, intending to deliver her and the world to an Imperial remnant force. However, fellow Alliance diplomat [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] led an armed Herdessan revolt that overthrew the Herdessan Guild's power and toppling their scheme.<ref name="SW88" />
